meta.title: Website & Mobile App Development Proposal | Web-App
meta.description: Web-App mobile application development and website to mobile app proposal.

hero.headline: Mobile applications built around your business.
hero.subheading: A clear route from reviewing your existing website or idea to defining the right scope, investment, and delivery plan for a mobile app.

sections.heading: The opportunity
sections.subheading: Choose a solution based on business needs, not technology for its own sake.
sections.introSuffix: thank you for considering Web-App. We propose helping you assess the best route to a mobile app: either extending a suitable existing website into an app experience or building a new application around your customers' and team's needs.

outcomes.title: Serve customers better
outcomes.body: Make key services, information, and customer journeys easier to access.

outcomes.title: Improve operations
outcomes.body: Support the business workflows that matter, with features scoped to your needs.

outcomes.title: Plan with confidence
outcomes.body: Review requirements first, then agree on deliverables, timeline, and final investment.

sections.heading: Start with a discovery phase
sections.subheading: A paid review before the final development scope and price are confirmed.

highlightCard.title: Website & Requirements Discovery
highlightCard.note: One-time discovery fee · Fixed fee for the agreed website review and discovery session.
highlightCard.body: For clients who already have a website or an existing digital service, Web-App reviews the current experience with you before preparing the final development scope.
items: Review of the existing website and key customer journeys
Discussion with the client to understand goals and pain points
Assessment of what can be reused and what may need to be built
Prioritized feature and integration requirements
Recommended delivery approach and key dependencies
Written scope outline, estimated timeline, and final project quotation

softCard.title: Know what you are committing to
softCard.body: The discovery phase is intended to reduce uncertainty before development starts. It helps both sides agree on the problem to solve, what is included, and how success will be assessed.
items: Clear list of proposed features and exclusions
Known assumptions and third-party dependencies
Milestones and realistic delivery estimate
Basis for the final fixed-scope quotation
softCard.calloutBody: the discovery fee covers assessment and scope definition only. Development, redesign, production code, and implementation are not included unless separately agreed in writing.

sections.footer: If you do not yet have a website, discovery can focus on business goals, users, workflows, and requirements instead. The exact discovery activities will be confirmed before the session.

sections.heading: Choose the right development route
sections.subheading: Indicative one-time development fees, subject to the discovery findings and agreed scope.

cards.title: Website to Mobile App
cards.note: Typical timeline: 1–8+ weeks, depending on features and review requirements.
cards.body: Suitable when the existing website is mobile-friendly and can support the intended app experience.
items: App shell, icon, and splash screen
Navigation and back-button handling
Website login and link handling where suitable
Optional notifications, deep links, and device features
Testing and release preparation as scoped

cards.title: Custom Mobile App
cards.note: Typical timeline: 3–16+ weeks, depending on complexity. MVP: 3–5 weeks; Standard Business App: 6–9 weeks; Advanced Platform: 10–16+ weeks.
cards.body: Suitable when the business needs new customer journeys, staff workflows, or functionality beyond the current website.
items: Purpose-built screens and navigation
Accounts and roles where required
Backend or API integration as scoped
Notifications and third-party services where included
Testing, handover, and release support as scoped
cards.rangeNoteBody: MVP GH₵8,000–15,000 · Standard Business App GH₵18,000–30,000 · Advanced Platform GH₵35,000–60,000+

sections.calloutBody: these ranges help with early budgeting. The final price will be based on the confirmed features, integrations, content, design complexity, security needs, and release requirements after discovery.

sections.heading: Package guide
sections.subheading: Examples of what the budget ranges generally represent. Final inclusions are agreed in the quotation.
rows: App shell, branding, navigation, basic testing
Starter features plus selected notifications, deep links, or sharing
Selected native screens, device features, or extra integrations
3–5 static screens, basic login, no complex backend
App solving a specific business problem
User profiles, push notifications, search/filtering, and connection to an existing database or API
Advanced security, real-time GPS tracking, payment integrations (Paystack/Flutterwave), and custom admin dashboards
sections.footer: The same budget can deliver different outcomes depending on the requirements. No package includes unlimited features, revisions, or integrations.

sections.heading: Delivery process
sections.subheading: A transparent sequence from first review through launch.

steps.title: 1. Discover
steps.body: Review the existing website or idea, meet with the client, and clarify goals and requirements.

steps.title: 2. Define & quote
steps.body: Agree on features, exclusions, acceptance criteria, milestones, and the final price.

steps.title: 3. Design & build
steps.body: Approve the user experience and develop the agreed functionality.

steps.title: 4. Test & review
steps.body: Test the agreed flows and review the app against acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 5. Handover
steps.body: Prepare release, provide agreed documentation, and complete handover.

steps.title: 6. Support
steps.body: Arrange optional maintenance and ongoing improvements if required.

sections.heading: Optional support and recurring costs
sections.subheading: Only included if selected and listed in the final quotation.

cards.title: Basic maintenance
cards.body: Agreed upkeep, compatibility checks, and limited support. Exact service limits will be stated in the maintenance plan.

cards.title: Active maintenance
cards.body: For active products needing more regular technical support and a defined allowance for small improvements.

sections.calloutBody: hosting, domain registration, developer accounts, paid APIs, SMS, email, maps, payment processing fees, and other subscriptions are separate unless expressly included in the final quotation.

sections.heading: Commercial terms and assumptions
sections.subheading: Clear responsibilities and boundaries from the start.

terms.title: Discovery fee
terms.body: The GH₵1,200 discovery fee covers the agreed review and scope-definition activities only. Any credit toward later development fees must be explicitly agreed in writing.

terms.title: Development payment schedule
terms.body: A typical schedule is 40% to begin, 30% at an agreed milestone, and 30% before final handover or release. The final schedule is confirmed in the quotation.

terms.title: Scope changes
terms.body: Features or revisions outside the approved scope may affect cost and delivery dates. Work on changes starts after written approval.

terms.title: Client responsibilities
terms.body: The client provides accurate content, brand assets, account access, feedback, and approvals within agreed timeframes.

terms.title: External approvals
terms.body: Apple App Store and Google Play approval, third-party availability, and external platform decisions cannot be guaranteed by Web-App.

terms.title: Ownership and support
terms.body: Source-code arrangements, licensing, warranty, support period, and ongoing maintenance will be stated in the final written agreement.

sections.footer: All prices are indicative and stated in Ghanaian cedis (GHS). Taxes, if applicable, will be stated separately. Final scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria will be confirmed before development begins.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.subheading: Begin with a clear review, then decide on the right investment.
paragraphs: We recommend starting with the Website & Requirements Discovery phase at GH₵1,200 when an existing website needs to be reviewed with you before the final scope and development price can be confirmed.

Following discovery, Web-App will provide a written scope outline, recommended approach, estimated timeline, and final project quotation. Development will begin only after the scope and commercial terms are approved.
